### What this PR does

Please describe what changes this PR introduces and why they are needed.

### Reviewer's guide to testing

If this PR changes functionality, list the steps needed to verify the changes. Include setup steps, test flows, and expected results.

### Things to focus on

1. Focus on the key behavior that changed
2. Check whether the test coverage is appropriate
3. Confirm the change matches the intended product behavior
4. Review edge cases and backward compatibility

### Checklist

Before submitting the PR, please consider if any of the following are needed:

- [ ] Update `CHANGELOG.md` if the changes would impact users
- [ ] Update `README.md`, if appropriate
- [ ] Update any relevant pages in `/docs`, if necessary
- [ ] For security fixes, the [Disclosure Policy](https://github.com/Shopify/shopify_app/blob/master/SECURITY.md#disclosure-policy) must be followed.
